headline: Approved Community Coach Corps pilot and first read of seven policies
summary: The committee approved personnel transactions, the pilot of the Lewiston Community Coach Corps with funding, and the first read of seven policies with edits. Reports covered school updates, community partnerships, City Council activity, and subcommittee progress.
decisions: Approved the pilot of the Lewiston Community Coach Corps with funds, 6-2.
Approved the first read of policies BDA, BE, EBCA, EBCF, JJIF, JLF, and JLF-E with edits, 8-0.

recognition was given to Natasha Turcotte, Rosemary Burgess and Aguinalda Miguel. 
 
SCHOOL REPORTS

 Luke Jensen - like the data – academic growth data. 
 Emily Levasseur – Data on interventions regarding bullying. 
 Janet Beaudoin – timeframe – 1 update per meeting.

Superintendent Jake Langlais presented. No vote.

Brochure with disclosure.
MINUTES – LEWISTON SCHOOL COMMITTEE MEETING HELD SEPTEMBER 14, 2026 – PAGE 7 
 
 
 
 
COMMUNITY COACH CORPS 
Superintendent Jake Langlais presented. 
VOTED: (1) Motion to approve the pilot of the Lewiston Community Coach Corps with funds. Scott 
Harriman – Elizabeth Eames. (6-2) M. Hird, J. Beaudoin. 8:27 PM 
 
Discussion about community factors included: 
- Would people still rent? 
- Is this the school’s responsibility? 
- Can we get a grant? 
- Elementary teams (bring back) 
- Harness the opportunities that exist. Rec, Y, YW, Other youth sports. 
- Consider Delegating. 
- We need to close the gap with Access. 
- Could be less like a “team or season” 
- Maybe a future conversation. 
- Anything enrichment, not just sports. 
- Compared investment to 200k for PD overtime. 
- Training for advisors. 
Public Input: 
Ronnie Paradis – worried about costs and other groups. 
Amy Smith – Insurance is a barrier. It could be low cost – sledding (example). 
 
SCHOOL COMMUNITY MEETING POLICY 
 Move to Item #10 and cover both items. 
 
POLICIES 
Assistant Superintendent Karen Paquette presented. 
VOTED: (2) Motion to approve the 1st read of the following policies with edits:  
Meghan Hird – Janet Beaudoin. (8-0) 8:49 PM 
a. BDA – School Committee Organizational Meeting 
b. BE – School Committee Meetings 
c. EBCA – Comprehensive Health and Safety Emergency and Management Plan 
d. EBCF – Automated External Defibrillators 
e. JJIF – Management of Concussions 
f. JLF – Reporting Child Abuse and Neglect 
g. JLF-E – Suspected Child Abuse or Neglect Form 
 
- Move “unless otherwise changed” to the start of the statement. 
- Check BDB for any needed changes. 
- Shift Vice Chair to nominate and confirmed. 
- EBCA – Review Sample with 1 member. 
 
REPORT FROM SCHOOL COMMITTEE CHAIR 
 Chairperson reported on MSBA – October offerings: Delegate Assembly, 10/24 and Board Chair  Workshop, 
10/28. 
 
REPORT FROM SCHOOL SUPERINTENDENT 
Superintendent Jake Langlais reported on JROTC. Junior Maine Guide Curriculum has started up. The 
Superintendent and Assistant Superintendent visited a program in Rhode Island - “BOATS” and will visit
MINUTES – LEWISTON SCHOOL COMMITTEE MEETING HELD SEPTEMBER 14, 2026 – PAGE 8 
 
St. George, the Grace Innovation Center, at the end of the week,. E-Rate is a big discussion - what our 
impact would be. The After 2 program has begun. Educate Maine put out a report on research strategies for 
reading and schools. Honorees will be recognized at an upcoming SC meeting, Abby McCoy, Maine 
Teacher of The Year Finalist and Donna Olsen, Social Studies Maine Teacher of The Year. The Fall 
Conference for Superintendents is coming up in October. 
 
REPORT FROM CITY COUNCIL REP 
 City Council will meet tomorrow. Highlights are Mobile Home Rent, Ordinance for unregistered and 
 uninspected vehicles “parked” enforcement. 
 Economic Development is becoming a division of Administration. Community Development is becoming its 
 own department. 
 
UPDATES FROM SCHOOL COMMITTEE SUBCOMMITTEES 
 Curriculum 8/24 – grading review next meeting is 9/28. 
 Policy Committee – Ongoing. 
 
SCHOOL COMMITTEE COMMUNITY ANNOUNCEMENTS 
 None 
 
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS 
 Update on Nutrition with new rules. 
 Procedural rules as an item. 
 
ADJOURN 
VOTED: (3) Motion to adjourn. Janet Beaudoin – Meghan Hird (8-0) 9:01 PM.
